title: Company Performance
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has dominado el vocabulario esencial para hablar sobre el rendimiento financiero de una empresa.

parts.visual:
Términos financieros básicos: 
- Revenue (Ingresos totales). 
- Profit (Ganancias/Beneficios). 
- Loss (Pérdida). 
Ej: We made a huge profit this year (Tuvimos una gran ganancia este año).
parts.audio: Basic financial terms. Revenue is the total money received. Profit is the money you make after paying expenses. Loss is when you spend more than you make. For example: We made a huge profit this year.

parts.visual:
Verbos clave: 
- Break even (Alcanzar el punto de equilibrio, ni ganar ni perder). 
- Go bankrupt (Ir a la quiebra / Bancarrota). 
- Expand (Expandirse). 
Ej: The company went bankrupt in 2020 (La empresa quebró en 2020).
parts.audio: Key verbs. Break even means to neither make a profit nor suffer a loss. Go bankrupt means to lose all your money and close the business. Expand means to grow. For example: The company went bankrupt in 2020.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta relacionada con el rendimiento financiero.

questions.question: The total money a company receives from sales is called ____. (Ingresos).
After paying all expenses, the remaining money is the ____. (Ganancia).
Unfortunately, the company made a huge ____ last quarter. (Pérdida).
questions.explanation: Make a loss = tener una pérdida.

questions.question: We didn't make a profit, but we didn't lose money. We broke ____. (Punto de equilibrio).
questions.explanation: Break even (pasado broke even) = alcanzar el punto de equilibrio.

questions.question: Many small businesses went ____ during the crisis. (A la quiebra).
questions.explanation: Go bankrupt (went bankrupt) = ir a la quiebra, bancarrota.

questions.question: The company plans to ____ into the Asian market. (Expandirse).
questions.explanation: Expand into a market = expandirse a un mercado.

questions.question: Our ____ margin is very tight this year. (Margen de ganancia).
We need to reduce our ____ to increase profits. (Gastos).
Sales have ____ significantly since the new product launch. (Crecido).
The board of directors is happy with the company's ____. (Rendimiento).
questions.explanation: Company performance = rendimiento de la empresa.

questions.question: Our goal for next year is to double our ____. (Ingresos brutos).
questions.explanation: Double our revenue = duplicar nuestros ingresos.

questions.question: The startup is struggling and might go ____. (Quebrar).
We are operating at a ____ right now. (Operando a pérdida).
questions.explanation: Operate at a loss = operar con pérdidas.

questions.question: It takes time for a new business to break ____. (Alcanzar el equilibrio).
The financial ____ shows a positive trend. (Reporte).
We need investors to ____ the expansion. (Financiar).
The company's ____ dropped by 20%. (Acciones).
They announced a ____ in profits. (Aumento).
questions.explanation: A rise in profits = un aumento en las ganancias.

questions.question: The CEO presented the annual ____. (Resultados anuales).
Despite the crisis, we remained ____. (Rentables).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra financiera en inglés.

Net income is the ____. (Ganancia con P)

We hope to break ____. (Punto de equilibrio)
They went ____. (A la quiebra con B)
We want to ____ into Europe. (Expandirse con E)
We must reduce our ____. (Gastos con E)
Company ____ was excellent. (Rendimiento con P)
The business is ____. (Rentable - Adjetivo)
